ifMatchHash.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition: the sourceHash (lowercase sha256 hex of source) of the revision this edit is based on, as returned by app_file/get, app_file/update, app_file/create or application/struct. When set and it is not the hash of the file's current source, the WHOLE batch is refused with error code 1, reason appFileSourceMismatch, and data.reasonParams.files = [{id, title, source, sourceHash}] carrying the current server state of every mismatching file. Omit for last-write-wins.
